name: Keys
title: Keys: every service's key and settings, pasted in Settings, checked and kept sealed

permissions: calls each service's own API once with the values typed, to check them before they are kept, never showing them
touches.remove: the Settings section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, keyspage.js/.css, rouh/service_keys.py, rouh/web/service_keys.py, its addresses in rouh/project/urls.py, the calls in runtime.startup and manage.py, and this manifest; drop the service_key and service_check tables with a migration. Every service then reads the settings file alone again.
